title.narrative: EU Policy and Outreach Partnership in the US and Policy Dialogue Support Facility US

description.narrative: The EU will support its foreign policy objectives by means of strategic public diplomacy activities in the US. The contract will organise activities that engage with targeted audiences and stakeholders to foster mutual understanding and build transatlantic networks. It will enable dialogues and engagement with political, business, creative, and academic interlocutors as well as civil society and think tanks. It will also support policy dialogues in priority sectors of the partnership.
